content.short: Symbiote focuses on elevating Web3 startups in a 12-week journey with 50+ Mentors, 450+ Partners, 150+ Investors.
content.description: Symbiote aims to streamline the Web3 accelerator experience by providing founders with seamless access to venture capital, mentors, partners, and essential resources. By productizing acceleration, it reduces friction and speeds up growth for early-stage projects. Symbiote has incubated and supported leading Web3 teams and can offer substantial backing to ventures building blockchain infrastructure, spanning multiple ecosystems and stages. Its network connects teams with strategic collaborators, accelerating product-market fit and long-term impact.
content.meta: Symbiote accelerates Web3 startups in a 12-week program. Discover Symbiote and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
